Aetheria OS

A complete spatial audio-visual operating system running in modern web browsers.

The Challenge & Goal

Building a high-performance audio-visual canvas with sub-16ms latency without dropping frames on lower-end devices.

The Solution & Architecture

Implemented custom WebGL shaders, zero-copy buffer streaming, and a lightweight reactive state machine with Web Audio API synthesis.
